segments.en: Okay, tell me.
Where are you from?
I am from Ernakulam.
What do you do?
I work at a car showroom.
Is there no work there?
I have some work, I will leave soon. I will leave by 10 o'clock.
Okay, where are you calling from?
I am from Guruvayur.
Guruvayur, what do you do?
I am a Thirumeni.
Are you a temple priest?
Can you see me?
Jyothis?
No, no, no. There is no work for a priest.
What is your name?
My name is Sharanya.
Where is your place?
Pathanamthitta.
I work in Ernakulam.
Where do you stay?
I am in Ernakulam.
Is it a hostel?
Where do you stay, is it a hostel?
No, no, this is an apartment.
In which temple is Shanthi?
There is nothing in the temple now. I am old now, so there is no fever or anything.
I go occasionally if there is any program.
Oh, so do you know Jyothis?
No, no, no, no.
Is Jyothis a priest?
There are many priests.
Oh, some people say, what is it? Let me ask you one thing.
Is it true that Koodu-pathram is a lie?
I don't know. I don't know about that, I will just say I don't know. I don't know about Koodu-pathram or anything.
I don't know anything about that vessel.
That is not what I asked. My brother, I have a brother, my elder brother.
He got married, but not in a good way.
It is not Koodu-pathram, it is Koodothram.
Ah, that is it, that is it.
That girl's family, I and my mother...
Some people have experience, they say so. It might be true or not.
My brother's life is ruined.
Just call God, pray to God, that is all you can do.
But there is another thing, my brother's job is here in Hyderabad.
My brother is set up with a girl there, and that girl has a child there.
The wife there, my sister-in-law, is Hidumbi, she is in that girl's house.
She went there and got set up, right?
That girl is not needed, the brother is not needed, then legally they are just standing there.
So what will you do?
What to do? Tell God, pray well, chant the name every day. Do that.
Tell your brother, tell your family, that is the main thing.
My brother does not want that girl.
If he doesn't want her, pray to get rid of her. Pray that it becomes right.
No, Thirumeni, she will not leave, she wants money.
She is asking for a large amount.
We cannot make it right. We have to pray to God to help us.
I am a Hindu. I am a Hindu. Which is the best God in Hinduism?
There is nothing like that. All Gods are good. I will not say one God is good and another is bad. All Gods are good. You must have faith in God.
But I have only one God. I have only one God, that is a human.
Then go with your faith. Don't go with blind faith, go with your faith.
No, God will not come directly in front of us, he will only come in the form of humans.
That is all.
God will never come directly in front of us. So we are humans, now I see Thirumeni, I see Thirumeni randomly.
So God, I told you about my brother's things, right? So let me ask you one thing. That relationship should end.
The second relationship is a good relationship, my brother is happy.
She is not from our place, but she is very happy.
But in the first relationship, my brother has a child, a girl child.
In the second relationship, my brother has a boy child.
I don't have any opinion on that. If it is good, let it end.
Don't go to an astrologer and waste money.
Oh, I and my mother wasted money. Do you know Hari from Pathanamthitta? He is very famous.
I don't know, I don't know, I don't know.
I don't know, do you know?
Do you know Thirumeni?
No, he did a lot of things. What about the Plathi people?
I don't know. I don't go behind them, so I don't know.
Is that so?
My time is almost up, my money is running out.
Okay, okay.
Are you using WhatsApp?
I have WhatsApp.
